findings.statement: After repairing both count state and component structural identity, each GF(2) outcome bit still adds exactly one dimension beyond the affine repaired-coordinate span and the joint scalar target dimension is exactly two on all five tested carriers.
The canonical P/O binary encoding of ROLE_CAPPAR+ZOE is not affine-sufficient on any demanding tested carrier.
Complete observed square-free degree-2 P/O expansion is exact on 5x3-k3 and 4x4-k4 but leaves 24, 24, and 5 contradictions on 6x3-k3, 4x5-k4, and 6x3-k4 respectively.
The scalar output correction remaining two-dimensional does not imply quadratic structural realizability; output dimension and polynomial interaction degree are distinct properties.

nonclaims: The two scalar target dimensions are not yet identified with a closed-form pair of structural syndrome formulas.
Degree 3 is not yet known sufficient.
No Q-A/Q-F or standard-7x6 claim follows.
next_question: Do all mechanically generated square-free cubic P/O interactions eliminate the frozen degree-2 contradictions on 6x3-k3, 4x5-k4, and 6x3-k4?
